summary: Military aircraft high-energy manoeuvres up to 5,000 feet within 5 nautical miles of Hunderthwaite, at speeds up to 450 knots.
text:
AIR EXER. 1 MIL ACFT WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN
SUPPORT OF JTAC EXERCISE ON FREQUENCIES WI 5NM RADIUS OF 
543546N 0020335W (HUNDERTHWAITE). ACFT MAY OPERATE AT SPEEDS OF UP 
TO 450 KNOTS IAS AND MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER 
INFO AIC Y007/2023 REFERS. OPS CTC ON CH127.185 OR FREQUENCY
277.350MHZ. FOR INFO 07517 258611. AR-2026-9901/03.
